dateOriginal.description: Free-text date as given by the source, when it differs from the Gregorian-equivalent EDTF value in the paired date property. Paired with martialis:dateCalendar.

grantedBy.description: Person that granted the rank or honor. Granting organizations use conferredBy.

hasConfidence.description: Links an Assertion to its Confidence assessment.

hasEvidence.description: Links an entity (assertion, interaction, life event, or top-level entity) to its evidence records.

id.description: ULID of the record, or of a claim: every Assertion and Participation carries its own, the graded conclusions being exactly the nodes that have hasConfidence.

notes.description: A curatorial note recording what is known, suspected, or still to be investigated about a record. Addressed to a maintainer, not a reader (YAML: notes).

rankGrade.description: The specific grade within an enumerated RankingSystem's scheme (e.g. Menkyo Kaiden). Mutually exclusive with martialis:rankOrdinal/rankType.

rankOrdinal.description: The grade number within a numbered RankingSystem (e.g. 6 for 6th dan). Mutually exclusive with martialis:rankGrade.

rankStyle.description: The style the rank is in.

rankSystem.description: The RankingSystem a Style's practitioners are ranked in, or that a RankAssertion's rank belongs to. Absent on a Style means rank is unresearched.

rankType.description: Which half of a numbered ladder a grade is on: dan (ascending), kyu (descending), or dan_unspecified. Only meaningful for a 'numbered' system.

RankGrade.description: BJJ Belt Grade Vocabulary; Menkyo Grade Vocabulary; Unified Sports Classification System Grade Vocabulary
RankGrade.title: RankGrade

RankingSystem.description: A named, sourced grading system that a style's practitioners are ranked in, such as dan-kyu, menkyo or a state sports classification.

aka.description: Alternative names, as a language map.

derivedFromSystem.description: This RankingSystem's grading concept derives from a more generic ancestor system. Distinct from martialis:variantOf (style-to-style).

description.description: Reader-facing description, as a language map.

foundedEvent.description: Founding event with date, location, and sources. Used by Style, Organization, Place, and RankingSystem (YAML 'instituted').

gradeScheme.description: The skos:ConceptScheme enumerating this system's grades (see ontology/vocabularies.ttl), required when martialis:rankingSystemKind is 'enumerated'.

hasEvidence.description: Links an entity (assertion, interaction, life event, or top-level entity) to its evidence records.

id.description: ULID of the record, or of a claim: every Assertion and Participation carries its own, the graded conclusions being exactly the nodes that have hasConfidence.

maxOrdinal.description: Highest valid grade number (dan side), if this system bounds it. Absent for the unbounded default.

minOrdinal.description: Lowest valid grade number (kyu side), if this system bounds it. Absent for the unbounded default.

name.description: Primary name, as a language map.

notes.description: A curatorial note recording what is known, suspected, or still to be investigated about a record. Addressed to a maintainer, not a reader (YAML: notes).

rankSystemKind.description: 'numbered' (an open-ended integer ladder, recorded as rankType/rankOrdinal) or 'enumerated' (a fixed ordered list of grades, a skos:ConceptScheme).

type.description: Entity class, designating the node type.

RankingSystem.title: RankingSystem

Site.description: A site a Place or Organization occupied: its locality (required), an optional street address and map point, an optional Place it sat within, and the period when the sources date it. The only home for where a Place or Organization is; the current locality is the site or sites with no end year. No period means the period is unsourced, not that the site covers the record's whole life.

hasEvidence.description: Links an entity (assertion, interaction, life event, or top-level entity) to its evidence records.

location.description: An embedded place reference (free-text label, country code, optional authority IRI and point), not a Place entity. Carried by Site (where a Place or Organization is) and by Event and the life events (where something happened); a Place or Organization has no location of its own. The specific Place an event happened at is martialis:eventPlace; keeping the two on separate predicates keeps a Place entity and a GeoRef apart.

notes.description: A curatorial note recording what is known, suspected, or still to be investigated about a record. Addressed to a maintainer, not a reader (YAML: notes).

sitePeriod.description: The period during which a site was occupied. Absent means the period is unsourced.

withinPlace.description: The Place this site sat within (a dojo inside a hall, an HQ housed at a dojo), dated by the site's own period.

Site.title: Site

Source.description: A bibliographic source cited as evidence: a book, article, web page, video, thesis, interview or archival document. Its bibliographic form is sourceType.

accessedDate.description: When the curator consulted this source (CSL 'accessed').

archive.description: Archival repository holding this item (e.g. 'National Diet Library'). CSL 'archive'.

archiveCollection.description: Collection within the archive that holds this item. CSL 'archive_collection'.

archiveLocation.description: Location of this item within the archive (e.g. box and folder). CSL 'archive_location'.

archivedDate.description: Snapshot date of archiveUrl. Distinct from schema:archivedAt, which carries the archiveUrl IRI itself, not a date.

callNumber.description: Shelfmark or call number within the archive. CSL 'call-number'.

chapterNumber.description: Chapter number of this item within the containing work. CSL 'chapter-number'.

description.description: Reader-facing description, as a language map.

editionOf.description: Links a Source to the node recording which work it is an edition, translation, reprint, or facsimile of.

hasContributor.description: Links a Source to a contributor node (a CSL contributor role plus a CSL name-variable shape).

id.description: ULID of the record, or of a claim: every Assertion and Participation carries its own, the graded conclusions being exactly the nodes that have hasConfidence.

image.description: The single primary depiction of an entity. The multivalued photos gallery uses schema:image; a single-valued slot cannot share that IRI without its maxCount 1 shape firing on the gallery.

lineageTradition.description: True when the Source is a lineage or organisation recounting its own past (a school or federation history, a founding story, a genealogy chart, a densho), so it shares one origin with every other account from inside that lineage and cannot corroborate them. Not set on everything a body publishes: its record of its own act (a grade register, a same-day announcement, a current member list) is not tradition. Extends the Mills independence test; orthogonal to martialis:sourceClassification: an original densho is still lineage-internal.

notes.description: A curatorial note recording what is known, suspected, or still to be investigated about a record. Addressed to a maintainer, not a reader (YAML: notes).

partOf.description: The larger Source this one is part of: an article's journal or website edition, a chapter's book.

peerReview.description: Whether this Source was peer-reviewed before publication. Inherited from its container through partOf (materialized at export time) unless stated on the item. Absent when not established.

section.description: Section of the container in which this item appears (e.g. a newspaper section). CSL 'section'.

selfPublished.description: Whether the publisher and the contributor(s) are the same party. Preferably derived from the linked entities rather than asserted.

sourceClassification.description: The Source's form relative to the record it carries (Mills): original, derivative or authored. Set once on the Source.

sourceGenre.description: What the content is (biography, obituary, interview, promotional, ...), independent of sourceType's bibliographic form - a `webpage` can be any of these.

sourceType.description: The bibliographic form: a CSL-JSON item type, plus the extension 'website' (exported as CSL 'periodical'). Required on every Source except a dated state, which inherits it.

specializationOf.description: The resource this Source is one dated state of: a capture of a web page whose content changes, or a revised issue of a roster. The state inherits every field of that resource it does not state itself; evidence cites the state, never the resource.

title.description: A plain, unlocalised title (a Source). Required on every Source except a dated state, which inherits it (enforced in SHACL).

type.description: Entity class, designating the node type.

wikidata.description: The Wikidata item that IS this source, place reference or nationality, as a wd: CURIE. A source has one only when it is a work with its own item (a book, a periodical); a Wikipedia article has none, and the item of its subject is not its identity. An entity record lists its identity links, Wikidata among them, in sameAs.

Source.title: Source

SourceAssertionRelation.description: One evidence record: a Source plus the curator's reading of it, which says whether the Source supports the claim and how.

basedOnSource.description: The Source backing this evidence record.

evidenceType.description: How the cited information bears on the claim (Mills): direct, indirect or negative. Independent of martialis:supports, which gives the direction. Absent when not yet assessed.

informationType.description: The informant's proximity to the specific fact cited (Mills): primary (first-hand), secondary (learned from others) or undetermined (the informant cannot be identified). Set per citation. Absent when not yet assessed.

locator.description: Where the cited claim sits within the work (YAML: locator) - page number, timestamp, section, etc. Paired with martialis:sourceLocatorLabel.

locatorLabel.description: What kind of locator martialis:sourceLocation is: CSL's citation-locator vocabulary (page, volume, chapter, folio, section, timestamp, ...). Optional.

quotation.description: The passage of the source that states the claim, transcribed verbatim: the source's words, order, case and punctuation. Editorial interventions are square-bracketed, as in standard transcription: [...] for an omission inside the passage, [sic] after an error in the source, and a short clarifying insertion where the excerpt would be unclear without it; never a fact the source does not state.

supports.description: Whether the source supports or contradicts the assertion (true/false).

SourceAssertionRelation.title: SourceAssertionRelation

SourceType.description: CSL 1.0.2 item type of the source.
SourceType.title: SourceType

aka.description: Alternative names, as a language map.

confersRank.description: false asserts that this style confers no ranking system of its own (e.g. MMA). Distinct from omitting martialis:rankSystem, which means unresearched.

description.description: Reader-facing description, as a language map.

dissolvedEvent.description: Dissolution event, if applicable. Used by Style, Organization, and Place.

foundedEvent.description: Founding event with date, location, and sources. Used by Style, Organization, Place, and RankingSystem (YAML 'instituted').

hasEvidence.description: Links an entity (assertion, interaction, life event, or top-level entity) to its evidence records.

hasStyleRelationAssertion.description: Links a Style to its StyleRelationAssertions: typed, sourced relationships to other styles.

name.description: Primary name, as a language map.

photos.description: A gallery of depictions; the generic sdo:image relation.

rankSystem.description: The RankingSystem a Style's practitioners are ranked in, or that a RankAssertion's rank belongs to. Absent on a Style means rank is unresearched.

sameAs.description: The same entity in an external authority, as a CURIE naming the entity itself (not a web page about it): wd: (Wikidata), dbr: (DBpedia), viaf:, isni:, lcnaf: (Library of Congress names), ndlna: (National Diet Library), orcid:. Nothing else belongs here: a web page, a Wikipedia article or an official site is not an identity.

styleForm.description: How a style is composed or practised, independent of origin period: hybrid and/or sport. Multi-valued. 'sport' means principally rule-governed competition.

styleType.description: Origin period, deliberately culture-neutral: traditional, modern, other. Culture-specific period terms belong in tags.

type.description: Entity class, designating the node type.

TeacherAssertion.description: A claim that a person taught the subject a style. The teacher is martialis:teacher. With no teacher, the claim states that a teacher existed whom no source names: every interaction then needs a Place or Event anchor and a dated period, and no wasTaughtBy/teaches edge is materialized. A claim assessed doubtful or refuted stays a TeacherAssertion and gives no edge either. Evidence attaches to the interactions.

assertedStyle.description: The style associated with a teacher-student assertion, denial, or document-transmission claim (assertedStyle).

hasConfidence.description: Links an Assertion to its Confidence assessment.

notes.description: A curatorial note recording what is known, suspected, or still to be investigated about a record. Addressed to a maintainer, not a reader (YAML: notes).

role.description: Type of student-teacher relationship: student, uchi_deshi, seminar, private, examination, coach. Event roles use martialis:participationRole.

teacher.description: The teacher. Omit it when no source identifies the teacher; every interaction then needs a Place or Event anchor and a dated period.

interactionPeriod.description: The period during which this teacher-student interaction took place.

interactionPlace.description: The Place where a teacher-student interaction occurred. Materialized into the martialis:trainedAt convenience edge at export time, and into martialis:taughtAt when the teacher is identified.

notes.description: A curatorial note recording what is known, suspected, or still to be investigated about a record. Addressed to a maintainer, not a reader (YAML: notes).

TimeInterval.description: A time interval with optional start and end years.

endYear.description: The end of a TimeInterval; absent when the period is ongoing or unknown.

startYear.description: The start of a TimeInterval, as a bare integer year (xsd:integer rather than xsd:gYear).

Video.description: A video file about an entity: its URL, its attribution to a source and its rights status.

imageAttribution.description: Credits/attribution for an image or video, indicating its source. Distinct from hasEvidence: attribution carries no supports/contradicts semantics.

rights.description: Copyright or licence status of the media file itself, as one value on a single axis: a Creative Commons licence where one was granted, otherwise a rightsstatements.org statement. Absence means the status has not been evaluated. Distinct from imageAttribution, which credits the item to a source and makes no legal claim, and from informationType and evidenceType, which are epistemic.
